remarks: Seller is willing to do seller's concessions. This lovely updated home is brimming with charm and character. The minute you enter you will feel at home. The front foyer has an area perfect for a storage bench or sitting area, and an open staircase to the 2nd floor. There is a pocket door that separates the foyer and the living room, which flows right into the family room, highlighted by an inviting electric fireplace. There is an additional pocket door separating the family room and dining room. The beautifully updated kitchen features new stainless steel appliances, sleek granite countertops, and a spacious central island—perfect for cooking and entertaining. The 5th bedroom is a walkthrough room on the second floor. The third floor boasts great ceiling height and offers a 20x14 open area with ceiling fans, and a 14x18 room with open brick and a large closet. The square footage listed does NOT include the third floor. A covered front porch, complete with solar lights in the railings, adds the perfect touch for outdoor relaxation and curb appeal. All updates have been completed in 2025 and 2026 and include the kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, lighting, furnace, hot water tank, porch railing and more! The seller will leave a heat/AC unit for the third floor, and also a sump pump. Buyer can install them after closing, or for a higher price, seller will install them.  Offers will be reviewed as they are received. No escalation clauses per the seller.
